nodes.text:
1/ 📈 WWSCAN Weekly Data

Respiratory weekly update: Influenza A, Influenza B, & RSV are in ‘High’ category nationwide. SARS-CoV-2 is in  ‘Medium’ category. Other respiratory viruses (HMPV & EV-D68) remain in the ‘Low’ wastewater category nationwide and not in seasonal onset. https://t.co/gfsVFQLkkO

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 2/ COVID-19: Nationwide, SARS-CoV-2 is in the ‘Medium’ category with medium concentrations and a downward trend over the last 3 weeks. https://t.co/1WhFLrlQFm

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 3/ COVID-19 Variants: In sequencing data from a subset of WWSCAN sites, we are seeing the KP.1 variant in light green (48.4%) and KP.3 in light blue (23.3%) make up approximately 72% of variants. Note sequencing data has a longer lag of 1-2 weeks after collection. https://t.co/G3xriCal0A
